v2-sq-num.note: T2 V2-SQ-NUM: number safety in the spoken-quote parser (Codex P2s on #1032, planner spec 28 Nov). A fraction, multiplier or range before an amount leaves the price open with a question; a per-item word followed by VAT words is read; VAT words never change the number and raise a VAT question. Golden record changes only the parser hash. No migration, route, table or schema change.
